title: Woodstock Festival
description:
The **Woodstock Music Festival** in August 1969 attracted 400,000 people to a farm in New York, becoming an icon of the 1960s counterculture.

Despite rain, mud, and overcrowding, the festival featured legendary performances by Jimi Hendrix, Janis Joplin, The Who, and many others.

Woodstock symbolized the peace and music movement of the era.
